description: This file defines the class 'ValueDescriptorCollection', a collection class managing 'ValueDescriptor' objects. It provides methods to add descriptors, access them by index or name, check for a name, and iterate over the collection.

classes.name: ValueDescriptorCollection
classes.description: A collection class managing ValueDescriptors, supporting addition, lookup by index or name, containment check, and enumeration.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a ValueDescriptor to the collection, storing it in both list and dictionary.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to access a ValueDescriptor by its position in the list.

methods.name: this[string name]
methods.description: Indexer to access a ValueDescriptor by its name.

methods.name: HasName
methods.description: Checks if a ValueDescriptor with the given name exists in the collection.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the collection.
